t: Powerful Bosch GDX 18V-285 2-in-1 impact driver/wrench combines screwdriving and bolting in a single tool—eliminating the need for multiple tools on-site. Suitable for both indoor and outdoor use. Produces 285Nm torque and can perform bolting up to M18. Features 2-speed selection allowing user to choose the speed and torque for optimal speed and control based on the application. Ideal for M8, M10, and M12 bolts. Also drives self-drilling screws (4.2 and 4.8mm) in sheet metal, wood screws (4,5 and 8mm), and lag screws (M6, M8 and M10).
